t: Retirement of the $20 AI Assistant Plan
html:
AI Assistants are now included for agency users through Free AI & the $20/month AI Assistant Plan is being retired as part of Level Up 2026. Your plan stays active until your current billing cycle ends and then won't renew. No action is needed.

What is the $20 AI Assistant Plan retirement?

The AI Assistant Plan was an agency level subscription for AI Assistants including Ask AI & AI Studio for agency admins and users. These products are now part of Free AI* features for agency users and admins, & the AI Assistant plan is being deprecated.

Refer to the AI Pricing article for more details on Free AI* features. 

*Fair Usage Policy: Free AI features are subject to fair-use limits. Agency users on higher-tier plans receive increased allowances, and the $497 Founder Plan includes access to advanced Creator Studio models.

What this means for you

  • No extra cost: AI assistants are included for agency users and admins in the agency plans, subject to fair use limits.
  • Your current $20 Assistant Plan ends automatically: Your plan won’t renew after your current billing cycle, and it can’t be repurchased.
  • No effect on AI Employee Subscriptions: AI Employee Growth and Unlimited plans are not affected.
  • Sub-accounts: The $20/month AI Employee Starter Plan is available for sub-accounts if needed.

Prerequisites and Limitations

This change only affects agencies with an active AI Assistant Plan. AI Employee Growth and Unlimited plans are not affected. The plan can't be renewed or repurchased after your current billing cycle.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need to cancel the plan?
No, it ends automatically after your current billing cycle.


Q: Will I lose access to Ask AI and AI Studio when my plan ends?

No. Agency users and admins keep access through Free AI, included in your agency plan. To add AI for client sub

accounts, see How to Upgrade a Sub-Account to the AI Employee Starter Plan

Q: What happens when I reach my Free AI usage limits?

When agency users reach their Free AI limits, they can continue using AI through an eligible AI Employee subscription if they're working in a sub-account with one. Otherwise, AI pauses until the limit resets unless Extra Usage is enabled in AI Suite. With Extra Usage enabled, supported AI products continue at pay-per-use rates.

For more information, see Free AI for Agency Users.
